usedFor: Autopilot runs your clients, jobs and estimates; Dropbox keeps the documents. A “New Estimate” in Autopilot can run “Upload File to Dropbox” to file a copy for the job.

bestTemplate.name: “New Estimate” in Autopilot, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Estimates are the paperwork you most want a backup of, and the action drops each into a folder you choose.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” needs a public link to the file. Triggers like “Updated Estimate” fire on every change, so the same document can be uploaded again.
